title: DiLoc JSON Schedule Format
description: This schema describes the DiLoc JSON Schedule Format. Version of the Schema: 2.5.2

validFrom.title: validFrom
validFrom.description: The date-time from when the schedule is valid.

validTo.title: validTo
validTo.description: The date-time until this schedule is valid.

version.title: version
version.description: The version describes the version of the schedule. The version usually starts with 1.0 and is increased for newer versions 1.1, 1.2, etc)

djsfSchemaVersion.title: djsfSchemaVersion
djsfSchemaVersion.description: The version describes the djsf schema version of the generated schedule.

type.title: type
type.description: The type of the generated schedule ("period" or "day").

createdAt.title: createdAt
createdAt.description: The timestamp when the schedule is created in ISO-8601 format. For example: 2022-12-02T10:20:39+00:00

fileDownloadUrl.title: fileDownloadUrl
fileDownloadUrl.description: The URL with path to the API endpoint to download schedule audio files. The file path and mpi device id code are added as query parameter. Example: https://api.example.com/schedules/audio/download?filePath=abc/a.mp3&mpiDeviceIdCode=test

files.title: files
files.description: Contains a list of all files in the schedule and those essential for special announcements.

items.title: file
items.description: The file object contains all information about the file to find it in the schedule-file or download it from the DiLoc-Server.

filePath.title: filePath
filePath.description: The path to the file (including filename) relative to the files folder in the schedule file. This path is used in the playList of the enqueueFiles command.

md5Checksum.title: md5Checksum
md5Checksum.description: The md5 checksum of the file.

trains.title: trains
trains.description: Contains a list of all trains in the schedule.

items.title: train
items.description: The train object contains all information about a train.

trainNumber.title: trainNumber
trainNumber.description: The number of the train. This may contain alphanumeric symbols and dots.

piNumber.title: piNumber
piNumber.description: The pi number of the train. This may contain alphanumeric symbols and dots.

departureTime.title: departureTime
departureTime.description: The departure time of the train in H:i:s format.

product.title: product
product.description: The product information about a train.

routeStations.title: routeStations
routeStations.description: Contains all stations the train will travel.

connections.title: connections
connections.description: An array of connections that should be displayed at this station.

items.title: connection
items.description: Contains information about a connection at the station.

category.title: category
category.description: This gives information about how the train should be displayed.

departureTime.title: departureTime
departureTime.description: The time when the connected train/bus etc. departs

destination.title: destination
destination.description: The destination the connected product travels to.

line.title: line
line.description: The line of the connected product. For example: 201

note.title: note
note.description: A note containing additional information about the connection.

platform.title: platform
platform.description: The platform at which the connected product departs.Examples for this are 1, A or 3A.

product.title: product
product.description: The name of the product like 'S12' or 'IC', 'IR', etc. Depending on the content it may be necessary to display a pictogram of the given product. For example for the product IC, IR there are special pictograms in Switzerland that should be displayed in this case.

timeTableArrivalTime.title: timeTableArrivalTime
timeTableArrivalTime.description: The time table arrival time in seconds after the departure of the train. The order of the routeStations must be ascending over timeTableArrivalTime.

timeTableDepartureTime.title: timeTableDepartureTime
timeTableDepartureTime.description: The time table departure time in seconds after the departure of the train. If stopType equals 'passthrough' the timeTableDepartureTime must be the same like timeTableArrivalTime.

script.title: script
script.description: The script contains all necessary information to drive the passenger information for this train.

tracks.title: tracks
tracks.description: A track contains the information what a specific output device in the train should do.

identifier.title: identifier
identifier.description: The identifier that identifies the channel. This is unique per script.

startCommands.title: startCommands
startCommands.description: Contains commands that should be sent to the output when the train is activated by the driver.

travelsOnDays.title: travelsOnDays
travelsOnDays.description: This defines on which days the train travels. This only applies for period schedules. On day schedules only the trains that really travel on the day are included in the schedule.

nextNumber.title: nextNumber
nextNumber.description: The number of the next train in case the train returns as another train number. This can be used to directly select the next train when the train arrives at its destination station. This can also be used to define a continuation, when another train number continue the trip.

nextPiNumber.title: nextPiNumber
nextPiNumber.description: The pi number of the next train.

nextLinkType.title: nextLinkType
nextLinkType.description: Defines the link type of two train numbers.

items.title: linkType
items.description: Circular defines the link type for regular circulation trips. Continuation defines a link type for a train which does not circulate at the destination station.

multiTractionTrains.title: multiTractionTrains
multiTractionTrains.description: This could be null, an empty array or an array of objects. Null means that this trains does not have any multitraction partner. An empty array means that this trains is a multitraction partner for another leading train. And an array of objects means that this train has multitraction partner and it's the leading train. The order of the trains in the array defines the order of trains in the multitraction.

specialAnnouncements.title: specialAnnouncements
specialAnnouncements.description: Contains a list of special announcements

items.title: specialAnnouncement
items.description: The specialAnnouncement encapsulates details and data of a special announcement

name.title: name
name.description: The short name of the specialAnnouncement.

number.title: number
number.description: The number of the specialAnnouncement used mainly to easily find/identify a specialAnnouncement by the driver. This musst be a unique number.

sortOrder.title: sortOrder
sortOrder.description: An optional property that can be used by DiLoc|OnBoard to defines the order in which special announcements are arranged

commands.title: commands
commands.description: An array of commands that the specialAnnouncement will execute when it is activated

items.title: command
items.description: The parameters for the command. Parameters are command specific. So each command-type has different parameters.

name.title: name
name.description: The name of the command that should be sent.

on.title: on
on.description: Describes where the action should be executed. This can either be a negative number like -100 or one of the fixed strings 'halt' and 'start'. Number are interpreted as meters before/after the station. 'halt' means when the train halts at the given station. 'start' means when the train starts and should be used inside startCommands. For pre announcements, this should contain 'plannedDepartureTime'

timeOffset.title: timeOffset
timeOffset.description: This is required, if parameter 'on' is 'planneddeparturetime'. This should contain for example '-100' to trigger an announcement hundred seconds before planned departure time.

params.title: params
params.description: The parameters for the command. Parameters are command specific. So each command-type has different parameters.

showMessage.title: showMessage
showMessage.description: The parameters of the showMessage-command are still TBD.

line.title: line
line.description: The line that should be displayed. For example 'S21'.

destination.title: destination
destination.description: The name of the destination station that should be displayed.

via.title: via
via.description: The via stations that should be displayed.

trainNumber.title: trainNumber
trainNumber.description: The number of the train. This may contain alphanumeric symbols and dots.

text.title: text
text.description: The text that should be displayed.

text.title: text
text.description: The Text that should be announced by the passenger information system.

lang.title: lang
lang.description: The language the text is in. For example 'de' or 'en'

playList.title: playList
playList.description: A list of files that should be played in order. These files may only be text-fragments that form a complete sentence when played one after another.

items.title: fileName
items.description: A filename that should be played. This has to match with the filePath of one file in the files array of the schedule.

routeStationIdentifier.title: routeStationIdentifier
routeStationIdentifier.description: Identifies a station uniquely on a route. Contains the idCode and the sequence number of the station in the route.

idCode.title: idCode
idCode.description: The id code of the station, like APPZ for Appenzell.

sequenceNumber.title: sequenceNumber
sequenceNumber.description: The sequence number of the station on the route.

externalIdentifier.title: externalIdentifier
externalIdentifier.description: A unique identifier for the station, this could be any external identifier, for example the REC_ORT number of a VDV452 schedule Import.

number.title: number
number.description: The number of the train. This may contain alphanumeric symbols and dots.

piNumber.title: piNumber
piNumber.description: The pi number of the train. This may contain alphanumeric symbols and dots.

arrivalStationIdCode.title: arrivalStationIdCode
arrivalStationIdCode.description: The id code of the arrival station of this multitraction partner train.

showText.title: showText
showText.description: Can be used to display a predefined text on the configured output channels

channels.title: channels
channels.description: The output channels on which this command will be executed. For example: ['display_interior.pis', 'display_exterior.front', 'display_exterior.side']

text.title: text
text.description: The text that should be displayed. For a multi language text, the text can be defined in different languages with a '|' separator, for example: 'Willkommen|Welcome|Bienvenue'

showDestination.title: showDestination
showDestination.description: Can be used to display the destination of the train on the displays.

channels.title: channels
channels.description: The output channels on which this command will be executed. For example: ['display_exterior.side', 'display_exterior.front']

line.title: line
line.description: The line that should be displayed. For example 'S21'.

destination.title: destination
destination.description: The name of the destination station that should be displayed.

via.title: via
via.description: (optional) The via stations that should be displayed.

trainNumber.title: trainNumber
trainNumber.description: The number of the train. This may contain alphanumeric symbols and dots.

showNote.title: showNote
showNote.description: Can be used to display a predefined text with a predefined title on the TFT devices.

type.title: type
type.description: When the type is notice, this will be cause usually displaying the announcement's title with a blue background, this is mainly used for operational informations. When the type is alert, the title's background will be red, this is mainly used for disruption informations.

channels.title: channels
channels.description: The output channels on which this command will be executed. For example: ['display_interior.pis']

text.title: text
text.description: The text that should be displayed.

enqueueAlert.title: enqueueAlert
enqueueAlert.description: Can be used to simultaneously play a list audio files and to display the according information text on the TFTs

type.title: type
type.description: When the type is notice, this will be cause usually displaying the announcement's title with a blue background, this is mainly used for operational informations. When the type is alert, the title's background will be red, this is mainly used for disruption informations.

autoCancel.title: autoCancel
autoCancel.description: Indicates that this command should immediately be canceled to not be observed as an active schedule command override

channels.title: channels
channels.description: The output channels on which this command will be executed. For example: ['audio_interior.pis', 'audio_exterior.pis']

announcements.title: announcements
announcements.description: A list of announcements that should be played in order. This can be a list of localized announcements.

title.title: title
title.description: The title of the announcement that should be displayed on the displays.

text.title: text
text.description: The visual text of the announcement that should be displayed on the displays.

files.title: files
files.description: A list of files that should be played in order. These files may only be text-fragments that form a complete sentence when played one after another.

items.title: fileName
items.description: A filename that should be played. This has to match with the filePath of one file in the files array of the schedule.

enqueueFiles.title: enqueueFiles
enqueueFiles.description: Can be used to play a list audio files.

channels.title: channels
channels.description: The output channels on which this command will be executed. For example: ['audio_interior.pis', 'audio_exterior.pis']

playList.title: playList
playList.description: A list of files that should be played in order. These files may only be text-fragments that form a complete sentence when played one after another.

items.title: fileName
items.description: A filename that should be played. This has to match with the filePath of one file in the files array of the schedule.
